findings.highlight: It's so unfair I got a piece of shit like Rider!
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーなんてカスを掴ませやがって
findings.governingReading: おまえたち followed by 掴ませやがって explicitly accuses his interlocutors of giving him a worthless Rider.
findings.explanation: The accusation that they foisted Rider on him becomes merely receiving a bad Servant.
